authorization_evaluation.reason: PR18 pilot temporal correspondence now holds, but semantic correspondence and exact frozen preprocessing correspondence remain unestablished; temporal sufficiency alone does not authorize model invocation.

pilot_fresh_cadence_finding.basis: Both corrected pilot cadences approach their telemetry row cadences, and pilot phase_age_ms p95 is 15 ms versus 195627 ms in the legacy long log. The earlier (a) verdict was based on a faulty phase-age-decrease estimator that undercounted always-low pilot age values.

comparison.computation: for each pilot, compare corrected cadence with its telemetry row cadence and superseded age-decrease cadence; explicitly require pilot phase-age p95 below legacy p95
